title: agentdag map manifest
description: manifest/<map_id>.json, written by the reducer of each map: branch -> record ref (design 3.1). Never a branch write-back into coordinator state.

map_id.description: Identifier of the map node this manifest belongs to.

branch_id.description: Identifier of this fan-out branch, unique within the map.

item.description: The input item this branch processed. Left as an open JSON type since the design does not pin a shape: it is whatever the map is fanning out over (a string, number, or object).

node_id.description: The node_id dispatched for this branch.

record_ref.description: Path to this branch's result-record.json under the run store.

status.description: The branch's result status, same enum as result-record.status (2.2).

reduced_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp with an explicit +00:00 offset, produced by the scheduler when the reducer ran (3.3: coordinator code never calls the clock itself).

reducer_version.description: Version identifier of the reduce logic that produced this manifest, for replay auditing.
